intro.title: Post-Operative Massages in Turrialba
intro.tagline: Aesthetic recovery with professional support, wellness, and protocols designed to help you feel better throughout your recovery journey.
intro.p1: After cosmetic surgery, your body needs much more than rest. It needs specialized care, proper lymphatic drainage, and post-operative protocols designed to support recovery, help reduce swelling, and make your recovery process more comfortable and reassuring.
intro.p2: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center, we combine wellness, aesthetics, and personalized care to provide a post-operative experience focused on your comfort, aesthetic recovery, and personalized support.

frustration.title: Did you recently undergo cosmetic surgery and are now looking for support during your recovery?
frustration.intro: After an aesthetic procedure, many people experience:
items: A feeling of tightness or heaviness
Anxiety about not seeing results quickly
frustration.closing: And although the surgery is over... Recovery is a CRITICAL part of the overall process.
frustration.highlight: This is where post-operative massages can make an important difference.

whatIs.title: What Are Post-Operative Massages?
whatIs.desc: Post-operative massages are specialized protocols designed to support the aesthetic recovery process through techniques focused on lymphatic drainage, physical well-being, and support during recovery following surgical procedures.
whatIs.note: At MJ Estética & Wellness Center, each session is adapted to your individual recovery process and progress, helping you feel more comfortable throughout your recovery journey.
